name: First Presbyterian Church Courtyard and Grounds
description: First Presbyterian in Bennettsville sits on a downtown block, so the courtyard, the front, and the playground are all in the same view. We put in new walks, sodded the lawns, and planted the beds along the street and beside the play area. People pass through every day, and it still looks cared for from the sidewalk.
metaDescription: New walks, sod, and planting at First Presbyterian in Bennettsville, across the courtyard, the front, and the playground.
story: The church is on a downtown block, so the courtyard, the front, and the playground are all in the same view. We put in new walks, sodded the lawns, and planted the beds, including a screen along the fence by the street. The front, around the sign and the steps, was done the same way. People walk through it every day, and it still looks pulled together from the sidewalk.
